subject: racers
author: SUFFUR
body:
I have to say when I saw Modnation racer I got a little wood going on, but for GT5 most of my friends near me, have skipped it for Forza 3, true it may have every car ever invented but it 3 years to late, and the rumour mill around it is shocking, like it was not going to be released till PS4, lol. Then again I don't have a PS3, lol.

I know we are getting a split/second velocity demo, saw via twitter and Facebooook, but i was looking forward to Joy Ride!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: More games
author: Exlonox
body: For PS3 gamers, there's also ModNation Racers and Gran Turismo 5.
